contract: offline artifact / fault-injection corpus (fix-dv-19.04) for google-signin — sibling of 19.01–19.03. Each case injects a fault, runs a state/output ORACLE (not a provider stub judging itself), records exit/trace/environment. DV-19: the counterexample FAILS pre-fix, PASSES post-fix, verified by STATE/OUTPUTS, release-tied.
release_tie: the fix ships in a tagged release; a counterexample that passes pre-fix is not a fix

environment.note: GIS/token stubs are inputs, never the oracle

cases.fault: client generates the nonce and POSTs it; backend skips the check when nonce is absent
cases.prefix_expect: FAIL (a stolen token with the nonce field deleted replays)
cases.postfix_expect: PASS (server-issued nonce, stored, single-use consumed; missing rejected)

cases.fault: email_verified=true treated as current inbox ownership for any domain
cases.prefix_expect: FAIL (a non-hd third-party email auto-links without re-verification)
cases.postfix_expect: PASS (auto-link only where the claim is authoritative: Gmail/hd; else re-verify)

cases.fault: missing Sec-Fetch-Site treated as same-origin; g_csrf_token not double-submitted
cases.prefix_expect: FAIL (a cross-site POST with no Sec-Fetch-Site passes)
cases.postfix_expect: PASS (missing Sec-Fetch-Site is NOT same-origin; g_csrf_token double-submit verified)
